task: route the diagnosed causal component to its unique documented owner, or abstain
citation_semantics: unordered exact minimal set; duplicates and extra citations invalid for scoring; route cites decisive diagnosis and ownership; abstention cites only the evidence establishing its reason; self-contained corrections replace superseded notes
protocol_validation: schema, enum, supplied owner roster and citation IDs only; semantic labels used exclusively by offline scoring
incomplete_policy: no aggregate score when any selected record is missing or unknown; stale/refused receipts cannot contribute current success
split_policy: case and family IDs unique; no family crosses calibration and heldout; exact evidence texts cannot cross splits
scope: synthetic smoke corpus; no statistical model-performance claim
